sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The prior defect remains unresolved: for a CP propeller with pitchValueKnown=false, the candidate checks only the presence, datatype, and unit of both pitch quantities and does not validate that propellerPitchAtMcrBollard equals 0.7 × propellerPitchAtMcrFreeRunning, allowing arbitrary values to pass. The COMPLETE comparisonModel must be encoded using tolerance bounds scaled from the expected 0.7 × free-running value, not exact equality. Because the assigned DIRECT_STATIC mode does not permit this arithmetic, resolve the verification-mode/requirement-model inconsistency upstream before regeneration; do not add a calculation query while retaining DIRECT_STATIC.
